Card Q&A.a: No, this card's  effect does not allow ignoring digivolution requirements, so you can only digivolve into a card that meets the digivolution requirements.
Card Q&A.q: When I use this card's  effect to digivolve into a Digimon card with [Gallantmon] in its name in the hand, can it digivolve regardless of its digivolution requirements?

Effect: [Main] You may play 1 [Guilmon] or [Takato Matsuki] from your hand or trash without paying the cost. Then, place this card in the battle area.
[All Turns] When an opponent's level 5 or higher Digimon is played, ＜Delay＞.
・1 of your Digimon may digivolve into a Digimon card with [Gallantmon] in its name in the hand without paying the cost.
